title: Anthropic Could Be Worth $2 Trillion When It Goes Public - Slashdot

content_html:
An anonymous reader quotes a report from the Financial Times: Anthropic investors expect the AI startup to float at a valuation of $2 trillion or more in October, a dizzying figure that would eclipse SpaceX and make the AI lab's debut the largest-ever initial public offering. Half a dozen of the company's backers told the FT that Anthropic's rapidly rising revenue would enable it to more than double its current valuation in a planned autumn float. A listing at that level could unlock billions of dollars in gains for the five-year-old company's early investors but would also test public markets that are growing more nervous about the AI boom.

Anthropic's backers say booming demand for the lab's advanced AI models and tools justifies their lofty expectations. Investors expect the Claude maker's annualized revenue to be between $100 billion and $120 billion by the end of 2026 -- using the startup's preferred measure, which infers full-year sales from recent performance -- up by more than 10 times over the course of 2026. "If Anthropic is growing 800 percent a year, you'd think at the incredibly low end they would trade at 30 times [revenue]," said one investor in the group. "That would make them a $3 trillion company."

According to Bloomberg (paywalled), Anthropic is currently in talks to acquire Decart AI for roughly $6 billion.

"Decart develops world models alongside software designed to lower AI training expenses by improving how efficiently chips are utilized," reports Quartz. "That capability could allow Anthropic to get more out of its current infrastructure as demand grows. If the deal closes, Decart's team would join Anthropic's inference and performance organization."

content_html_zh:
一位匿名读者引用了英国《金融时报》的一篇报道：人类投资者预计这家人工智能初创公司在 10 月份的估值将达到 2 万亿美元或更高，这个令人眼花缭乱的数字将超越 SpaceX，并使人工智能实验室的首次公开募股成为有史以来规模最大的首次公开募股。 该公司的六名支持者告诉英国《金融时报》，Anthropic 快速增长的收入将使其在计划的秋季上市中将当前估值提高一倍以上。 这种级别的上市可能会为这家成立五年的公司的早期投资者带来数十亿美元的收益，但也会考验对人工智能热潮越来越紧张的公共市场。 Anthropic 的支持者表示，对该实验室先进人工智能模型和工具的需求不断增长，证明了他们的远大期望。 投资者预计，到 2026 年底，这家克劳德制造商的年化收入将在 1000 亿美元至 1200 亿美元之间（使用该初创公司的首选衡量标准，即根据近期业绩推断全年销售额），在 2026 年期间将增长 10 倍以上。 “如果 Anthropic 每年增长 800%，你会认为在令人难以置信的低端，他们的交易价格会是[收入]的 30 倍，”该集团的一位投资者表示。 “这将使他们成为一家价值 3 万亿美元的公司。” 据彭博社（付费墙）报道，Anthropic 目前正在洽谈以约 60 亿美元收购 Decart AI。

Quartz 报道称：“Decart 开发了世界模型以及软件，旨在通过提高芯片的利用效率来降低人工智能培训费用。” “随着需求的增长，这种能力可以让 Anthropic 从其当前的基础设施中获得更多收益。 如果交易完成，Decart 的团队将加入 Anthropic 的推理和性能组织。”
